errors.text_span: На графиката са представени шест линии.

errors.evidence: The red, dashed line uses circle markers, not triangular ones.

errors.text_span: се изменя от стойност около 67 на 75 по оста X
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the values 67 and 75 are on the X-axis. These are Accuracy values from the Y-axis. The X-axis represents 'Sampling Time'.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 73 при стойност 10 по оста X
errors.evidence: The red line's value at Sampling Time (X-axis) 10 is approximately 75, not 73. The overall maximum is approximately 78 at the end of the time scale.

errors.text_span: се изменя от стойност около 65 до приблизително 72 по оста X
errors.evidence: The description again incorrectly maps accuracy values (Y-axis) to the X-axis. Furthermore, the values are incorrect; the black line fluctuates between approximately 68 and 70.

errors.text_span: като има по-голяма промяна между 40 и 60 по оста X
errors.evidence: The black line is relatively stable between Sampling Time 40 and 60, fluctuating slightly between ~69 and ~70. It does not exhibit a 'larger change' in this interval.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 57 при стойност 30 по оста X
errors.evidence: For the blue line, at a Sampling Time of 30, the Accuracy is approximately 56, not 57.

errors.text_span: намалява до около 54 при стойност 70 по оста X
errors.evidence: The blue line ends at an Accuracy of approximately 56 at Sampling Time 70, it does not decrease to 54.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 52 при стойност 10 по оста X
errors.evidence: The orange line is at an Accuracy of about 50 at Sampling Time 10, not 52.

errors.text_span: намалява до около 48 при стойност 70 по оста X
errors.evidence: The orange line generally increases and ends at an Accuracy of approximately 55 at Sampling Time 70, it does not decrease to 48.

errors.text_span: се изменя от стойност около 40 до около 50 по оста X
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the values change 'on the X-axis'. These are Y-axis (Accuracy) values.

errors.text_span: Шестата е розова, пунктирана, с триъгълни маркери
errors.evidence: There is no pink line on the graph. The description hallucinates a line that does not exist.
The description completely omits the legend, which is crucial for identifying which line corresponds to which method (e.g., 'DiP', 'CoT', 'Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle').

errors.text_span: Es sind sechs Linien im Diagramm dargestellt.
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows seven distinct lines, not six. The legend also lists seven different methods.

errors.text_span: mit dreieckigen Markern
errors.evidence: The red dashed line for 'Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle' uses circular markers, not triangular ones.

errors.text_span: steigt auf etwa 73 bei einer Abtastzeit von 70 an
errors.evidence: For the 'Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle' line, the accuracy value at a sampling time of 70 is approximately 78, not 73. The value is around 73 at a sampling time of approximately 5.

errors.text_span: steigt auf etwa 72 bei einer Abtastzeit von 70 an
errors.evidence: The black line for 'Dynamic w/ Oracle' ends at an accuracy of approximately 69 at a sampling time of 70. It never reaches 72.

errors.text_span: eine orangefarbene durchgezogene Linie mit nach unten zeigenden Dreiecksmarkern, stellt „L2M“ dar
errors.evidence: The line for 'L2M' is light blue (cyan), not orange. Furthermore, its markers are upward-pointing triangles, not downward-pointing. The description incorrectly maps the name 'L2M' to the visual attributes of a different (or non-existent) line.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei einem Wert von 43 bei einer Abtastzeit von 0 und steigt auf etwa 53 bei einer Abtastzeit von 70 an
errors.evidence: The actual 'L2M' line starts at an accuracy of approximately 44 and ends at approximately 56. The values 43 and 53 are incorrect.

errors.text_span: mit nach links zeigenden Dreiecksmarkern
errors.evidence: The markers for the 'DiP' line are upward-pointing triangles. No line in the chart has left-pointing triangles.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei einem Wert von 43 bei einer Abtastzeit von 0
errors.evidence: The 'DiP' line starts at an accuracy value of approximately 40 at a sampling time of 0, not 43.

errors.text_span: stabilisiert sich auf etwa 50 bei einer Abtastzeit von 20 und bleibt bis zur Abtastzeit von 70 gleich
errors.evidence: The 'DiP' line does not remain the same after sampling time 20. It fluctuates, dipping to around 48 and rising to end at approximately 53 at time 70.

errors.text_span: Die sechste, eine grüne durchgezogene Linie mit Rautenmarkern, stellt „SBP“ dar und beginnt bei einem Wert von 49 bei einer Abtastzeit von 0, erreicht einen Spitzenwert von etwa 53 bei einer Abtastzeit von 10 und sinkt dann auf etwa 52 bei einer Abtastzeit von 70.
errors.evidence: This entire description is hallucinated. The 'SBP' line is light orange/peach with triangle markers, starts at an accuracy of ~40, and ends at ~55. There is no green line with diamond markers in the chart, and all the numerical values and trends described for it are incorrect for 'SBP'.
The description completely omits any mention of the 'AnP' method, which is represented by the orange solid line with triangle markers.
